1	# Change context — preference ID normalization (staged)
2	
3	## Intent and authority
4	- Explicit, source: /tmp/fr-advisory-bootstrap-20261018/claude-candidate-R9-recovery-isolated-2/README.md (lines 5-13).
5	- Accept preference IDs with surrounding whitespace: trim the ID before lookup.
6	- Preserve the resilient-read contract: up to three attempts on `TransientRead`, return first success;
7	  exhausted transient errors propagate; `MissingPreference` is permanent and propagates on the first
8	  attempt; reads have no side effects.
9	- User request: "review the staged preference ID normalization change". No further requirements supplied.
10	
11	## Change boundary
12	- Selector: staged changes (`git diff --cached`); no unstaged changes exist, so worktree files equal index blobs
13	  for reader.py and tests/test_reads.py.
14	- Review base: HEAD 7c0410c ("Review base"). Candidate: index.
15	- Changed: reader.py (1 line), tests/test_reads.py (renamed test + 3 new tests).
16	- Unchanged but affected: preferences.py (public entry `Preferences.read`), repository.py
17	  (`Repository.read_resilient` retry policy, `read_once`, `ScriptedBackend`, exception types).
18	
19	## Task Scope
20	No task scope available — review the diff on its own merits without assuming any feature-level design doc.
21	(No docs/feat/wip directory exists in the repository.)
22	
23	## Existing behavior
24	- Call path: Preferences.read(key) -> reader.read_preferences(repository, key) -> Repository.read_resilient(key)
25	  -> read_once(key) -> backend.read(key).
26	- Base behavior: key passed through unchanged. Candidate: key.strip() applied once before read_resilient.
27	
28	## Delivery constraints
29	- Python 3.9+, standard library only (README line 3). No deployment/flag/migration surface described.
30	
31	## Baselines
32	- Review base = HEAD 7c0410c. The base version of reader.py is fully contained in the diff hunk; repository.py
33	  and preferences.py are unchanged, so no separate historical bundle is required. No released/deployed baseline named.
34	
35	## Scenarios and attributed evidence
36	- Parent (orchestrator) executed `python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -v` on the candidate worktree
37	  (== index): 4 tests ran, all OK (test_permanent_error, test_retry_limit, test_transient_error, test_trim_key).
38	  This is attributed parent evidence; the reviewer has source-only access.
39	- Unverified by tests: non-string / None keys, keys that are empty or whitespace-only after trimming,
40	  internal whitespace, non-ASCII whitespace.
